spec_raw: Select value updates without triggering event handlers when interacted with via testing frameworks

spec_refined.title: Select: inputChange event not emitted when value is changed via DOM event
spec_refined.description: When testing frameworks (Playwright, Testing Library, WebDriver) dispatch a change event on the inner <select> element, the component's value is updated internally but the `inputChange` custom event is not reliably emitted to the host. This creates a disconnect between the component state and event-driven consumers.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatching a change event on the inner select updates this.value
inputChange is emitted when value changes via a DOM change event
The inputChange event payload reflects the new value
Setting value to the same existing value does not emit inputChange
Programmatic value prop changes do not trigger inputChange (only DOM events do)
All existing option items render with correct selected state
spec_refined.technical_notes: The inputChange handler at line ~121 does `this.value = event.target.value` followed by `this.inputChange.emit(event)`. The issue may be event ordering, or the emit happening before this.value is committed. High complexity: used across many consumer apps, event contract must not break.
